package.description: Offline encyclopedia for programming diagnostics and runtime errors.

en-US.description: Offline encyclopedia for programming diagnostics and runtime errors.
en-US.longDescription: LexiconError is a local-first desktop encyclopedia for compiler diagnostics, linter rules, runtime exceptions, configuration failures, and GPU runtime faults. It provides full-text offline search, structured root-cause guidance, trigger-versus-fix examples, situational context, and cross-language mappings.
en-US.name: LexiconError
